name: K16 compressor wheel, Al2139 AM F1 iteration
description: Iteration of the rejected AlSi10Mg F0, with Al2139 AM and blades of variable root-to-tip thickness. The 40.6/60.5 mm diameters and the 6+6 blade count remain the only published geometric facts; the F1 passes three ambient algebraic screens without becoming a functional wheel.

classification.intended_use: F0-F1 loop for material and thickness choice, CAD, thermodynamics, rotating disk, centrifugal tension, overspeed, expansion and imbalance; no manufacturing, rotation, installation or start-up authorized

provenance.record_license: All rights reserved (see LICENSE) for the concept, the script and the calculations; no Porsche/BorgWarner/EOS photograph, surface or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: Invasion Auto Products - declared internal data of the right-hand 993 Turbo K16
sources.notes: Declares wheel 53241232006, 40.6 mm inducer, 60.5 mm exducer and 6+6 blades. No profile, tolerance, material or process. See SRC-INVASIONAUTOPRODUCTS-993-K16-INTERNAL-DATA.

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - context of 993 turbochargers and wheels
sources.notes: Places the twin-turbo system and upgrade wheels, but provides no additive K16 wheel and no geometry. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-K16-COMPRESSOR-WHEEL-CANDIDATE.

sources.title: EOS Aluminium Al2139 AM for EOS M 290, 60 micrometers
sources.notes: Publishes TRL 3, 0.4 mm minimum wall, density >=2.84 g/cm3, mean defects 0.2-0.3% and ambient T4 properties of 460/520 MPa vertical. See SRC-EOS-AL2139-AM-M290-60UM.

sources.title: Project AlSi10Mg K16 wheel F0
sources.notes: The F0 produced 390.9 MPa at the blade root at 1.2x and an ambient ratio of 0.627 against 245 MPa; it is the rejected predecessor, not physical evidence.

sources.title: TurboMaster - principles for reading a compressor map
sources.notes: Methodology only; no usable K16 map. See SRC-TURBOMAP-COMPRESSOR-MAP-METHODOLOGY.

post_processing: orientation, blade supports and recoater strategy to be qualified
EOS single-step heat treatment to be contracted with machine, parameters and coupons
HIP to be decided on defects, toughness, HCF and overspeed results
machining of the bore, back face, nose, faces and balancing datums
final profiling and controlled aerodynamic finishing of each blade and fillet
individual balancing then rotor-assembly balancing, spin proof and contained overspeed
supplier_requirements: traceable material set Al2139AM_060_CoreM291_110, machine, software, parameters, powder and lot
oriented coupons with tensile, HCF, toughness, crack growth and defects at rotor temperature
distortion witnesses and capability of the 0.8 mm tips after finishing
full CT before/after machining with defect criteria by zone, and metallography

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Qualify the Al2139 interface with shaft, nut and backplate, as well as fretting, corrosion, condensate and differential expansion.

known_limits: The 40.6/60.5 mm diameters, the 6+6 count and the part numbers remain the only published geometric facts.
The 3.0->0.8 and 2.4->0.8 mm thicknesses are synthetic; the CAD approximates them with four radial segments.
The 38.49 g CAD mass depends entirely on the F1 and the EOS density, with no comparison to a real K16 wheel.
The ambient root ratio of 1.986 is an algebraic improvement over the F0's 0.627, not a certified rotor margin.
The 1.5 criterion, Mach 0.9, 1.2x overspeed and all aerothermal conditions remain regression inputs.
The 460 MPa value concerns ambient T4 specimens from a TRL 3 process, not HCF or hot burst.
The radial-segment blades are not aerodynamic; no map, rotating CFD or housing interface is available.
The STEP proves only a readable BREP; it is authorized neither for manufacturing, nor for rotation, nor for a turbo or an engine.
